caption: The drawing features a single object centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The object is a transparent, bell-shaped glass container with a curved handle on its right side. Inside the glass container, the form of a coiled, light gray snake is visible. The top of the container is sealed with a metallic, brass-colored lid fitted with a vertically oriented, rounded, brass spout. Directly to the right of the glass container, the name "HARRY GROSSEN" is neatly inscribed in small, uppercase letters. The composition is minimalistic, and the color palette includes clear and reflective whites, grays, brass-toned yellows, and muted background tones.
title: Glass Camphene Lamp
